title: Repair a misunderstanding with clarification

audience.description: Learners who can take part in short workplace conversations and want to repair misunderstandings.

objectives: Notice when a speaker needs clarification.
Produce a polite clarification request that keeps the conversation moving.
context: A colleague gives an instruction that is difficult to hear in a busy office.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Please upload the revised file before lunch.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Sorry, could you say that again?

task.prompt: Reply as speaker B with a polite request for clarification.
task.revision_prompt: Revise your reply so it acknowledges the problem and asks for the missing information.
task.transfer_prompt: Imagine a noisy train station. Ask another person to repeat a time or platform number.

dimensions.label: Polite repair opening
dimensions.rationale: A brief apology or softener signals that the request is cooperative.
dimensions.missing_guidance: Start with a softener such as sorry before asking the speaker to repeat.

dimensions.label: Clear clarification request
dimensions.rationale: The listener explicitly asks the speaker to repeat the unclear information.
dimensions.missing_guidance: Ask the speaker to say the information again so the conversation can continue.
